task.title: Add analytics time-zone settings and privacy explanations
task.input: analytics-aggregate, the admin shell and the current user's permissions, and the existing privacy content
task.output: The ADMIN time-zone form, metric definitions and consistent privacy explanations
task.accept: 1) Entry: admin settings-link leads to the analytics section of /admin/settings; the data sources are GET/PATCH /api/admin/settings/analytics; clicking Save must send expectedVersion and show the actual new revision/recomputation range; invalid IANA input or direct non-ADMIN requests must not change the original value (E-58, E-59). 2) Entry: footer privacy-link leads to /[locale]/privacy; explain the scope of consented anonymous browsers and separation of necessary chat cookies from analytics; show the site time zone/coverage period on the page, with admin D1-D6 checks at all three viewports and a GIF recording of the requests (E-45, E-55).
